purpose: Hold the full forecasting/backtest/allocation/evaluation engine fixed while changing only the signal feature set.

amendment_policy.rule: After any scored Stage-2 test result is viewed, no frozen parameter may change without incrementing the config version and rerunning every system on the same dates.
amendment_policy.bug_fix_exception: A true implementation bug may be fixed only if documented before rerun; all systems must be rerun and prior affected outputs invalidated.

universe.primary_market_data: Daily ex-dividend-adjusted total-return series, preferably Bloomberg total-return index; exact extracted files are hashed before first scored run.
universe.risk_free: 1-month US Treasury-bill cash return accrued over the exact holding period; exact source snapshot is hashed before first scored run.

decision_and_execution.decision_time: 20:00 America/New_York on the last trading day of each calendar month
decision_and_execution.execution: Official close of the first trading day after the decision date
decision_and_execution.holding_period: From that execution close to the official close of the first trading day after the next month-end decision
decision_and_execution.target: Asset total return over the holding period minus risk-free return accrued over the identical dates
decision_and_execution.training_label_rule: At decision month t, completed labels only through decision month t-2 may be used.

sample.burn_in_training_labels: Decision months 2015-02 through 2019-01 (48 completed labels available by the first scored forecast)
sample.prospective_start_rule: First month-end after the complete A/B/C/D signal-generation artifacts and this backtest config are frozen before the decision timestamp.

system_A.reason: Keep the baseline definition-consistent, point-in-time auditable, and aligned with the Stage-1 architecture selection.

macro_feature_construction.surprise: First-print actual minus Bloomberg median consensus
macro_feature_construction.zscore_window: Prior 12 releases only; current release excluded
macro_feature_construction.monthly_aggregation: Mean if multiple releases of the same indicator occur in one calendar month
macro_feature_construction.no_release: Missing before model scaling; after training-only scaling, missing standardized value is set to 0

credit_level.definition: Month-end Baa corporate-minus-10Y Treasury credit spread level
credit_level.timing: Latest observation with documented availability by decision_time

credit_change_3m.definition: Current credit spread level minus its level three calendar months earlier

curve_10y_3m.definition: 10Y Treasury constant-maturity yield minus 3M Treasury constant-maturity yield

vrp_proxy.realized_variance: sum((daily SPY log return in decimal)^2) * 10000 over the last 22 trading days ending on the decision date
vrp_proxy.timing: Use end-of-day VIX and SPY observations available by the 20:00 ET decision snapshot

own_asset_momentum_12m.definition: Each asset's own trailing 12-month excess total return ending at the decision snapshot

system_B_runs.selection_rule: Do not choose the best component after test results and relabel it as the primary System B. B-All is the predeclared confirmatory conventional-signal system; component runs are attribution diagnostics.

same_between_C_and_D: prompt template except retrieval-structure instructions required by the treatment
systems_C_D_shared_backtest_interface.categorical_encoding: Insufficient is the reference state; Supported and Contradicted are explicit indicators. Do not map categories to arbitrary +1/-1 scores.
systems_C_D_shared_backtest_interface.contamination_rule: Historical C/D periods before a defensible model-knowledge cutoff boundary are diagnostic, not clean evidence. Prospective post-freeze evidence is the cleanest C/D evidence.

controls.C_permuted: Recommended placebo; permute frozen C labels across months and rerun Ridge without new LLM calls.
controls.D_random_graph: Recommended causal-graph placebo if implementation bandwidth permits.
controls.A_mechanical_labels: Optional robustness, not required for the main four-system table.

forecast_model.model: Separate Ridge regression for each asset
forecast_model.feature_scaling: Mean/std fit only on finite observed feature values inside the current training fold

inner_cv.scheme: Expanding one-step-ahead CV inside the outer training sample

forecast_model.alpha_tie_rule: Choose the more strongly regularized candidate

allocation.role: Secondary evidence; forecast performance is primary

covariance.inputs: Trailing realized asset excess returns available by decision time

omega.primary_test_rule: Diagonal forecast-error variance estimated from System A development-period OOS errors only, then frozen and shared by A/B/C/D during the historical test
omega.reason: Keep forecast-to-weight mapping comparable so System B/C/D do not receive a different uncertainty calibration merely because they are different systems.

allocation.optimizer: Same bounded optimizer for every system

costs_and_turnover.definition: 5 bps charged to each dollar of traded notional

benchmarks.forecast: Expanding historical mean excess-return forecast using only completed labels through t-2
benchmarks.portfolio_1: Historical-mean forecasts passed through the identical allocator and costs
benchmarks.portfolio_2: 45/35/20 monthly-rebalanced static allocation with the identical transaction-cost accounting

evaluation.loss_normalization: For each asset/month, divide squared forecast error by the expanding realized-return variance estimated using information available through t-2; average equally across SPY/IEF/LQD.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap over months, resampling the three assets jointly

multiple_testing.main_family: Holm correction at 5% across B-All vs A, C vs A, and D vs C
multiple_testing.B_component_family: Report component comparisons as attribution diagnostics; if p-values are emphasized, Holm-correct within the five-component family.

evaluation.event_regime_analysis: Predeclared diagnostic only, never used to select or tune a signal after test results are viewed.

robustness_only_not_primary: Alternative macro standardization using 24 prior releases
data_integrity_gates: Every raw input file is SHA-256 hashed before the first scored Stage-2 run.
Every feature row has an available_at timestamp/date and must satisfy available_at <= decision_time.
Macro actuals are first prints; consensus is the pre-release Bloomberg median.
No latest-vintage ANFCI or GPR enters the primary A/B model.
ETF returns must be total returns with distributions aligned to ex-dates; adjusted-close reconstruction is unit-tested against a trusted total-return source.
All systems are scored on identical common dates.
No scored test output is generated until config and data hashes are written to the run log.
